C163.notes: SER AS-PH-002. Reverse Philippine Eagle (Pithecophaga jefferyi) wings spread · 50 SENTIMO · scientific name on rim · user shorthand 1984 ph + photo (obverse/date side not shown — Joseph dated 1984). Marcos-era copper-nickel — jeepney / sari-sari odd-change while the critically endangered eagle rode the nation’s small money. Country #26 — first actual Philippines flip. SER sibling: AS-PH-001. Philippines flips now 2.
C163.story: A 1984 Philippine 50-sentimo coin. One side shows the Philippine eagle with its wings spread, with the bird's scientific name around the edge. Struck in cupronickel.

C246.notes: SER AS-PH-001. Photo confirmed · user shorthand 1971. Portrait side Francisco Baltazar (Balagtas) left · SAMPUNG SENTIMOS · big 10 (arms / date reverse not shown — Joseph dated 1971). Pilipino Series aluminum — jeepney / sari-sari odd-change while the poet of Florante at Laura rode every ten-sentimo piece. open_questions: Type composition recorded as aluminum for Philippines 10 sentimos 1971 (Balagtas), but LastDodo and NGC list KM#198 as cupronickel, 2g, 17.5mm. Is the metal misrecorded?
